_note: Three states: HEALTHY, BROKEN, UNAVAILABLE. Only a human moves a source into or out of UNAVAILABLE, with a reviewer, a reason and a date (railway/source_freshness.py --classify-unavailable). A machine that may decide a source is permanently gone is a machine that can turn a real outage into a permanent hole. A BROKEN source keeps its first_detected forever and its age climbs until somebody fixes it or classifies it; it never ages out.
